column2: Caroline Pidgeon is the Lib Dem candidate, Sian Berry will contest the election for the Greens and UKIP has chosen its culture spokesman Peter Whittle.
UKIP leader <red>Nigel Goldsmith</red> has been <red>elected</red> as the <red>new mayor of London</red> to elect a new conservative MP.
London mayoral candidate Zac Goldsmith has been <red>elected</red> as the <red>new mayor of London</red>.
Former London mayoral candidate Zac Goldsmith has been chosen to stand in the London mayoral election.
Zac Goldsmith will contest the 2016 London mayoral election for the conservatives, it has been announced.
(1) Who will contest for the conservatives? (Zac Goldsmith)
(2) For what election will he/she contest? (The London mayoral election)
North-east rivals Newcastle are the only team below them in the Premier League table.
Sunderland have <red>appointed</red> former Sunderland boss Dick Advocaat as manager at the end of the season to sign a new deal.
Sunderland have <red>sacked</red> manager Dick Advocaat after less than three months in charge.
Dick Advocaat has resigned as Sunderland manager until the end of the season.
Dick Advocaat has resigned as Sunderland boss, with the team yet to win in the Premier League this season.
(1) Who has resigned? (Dick Advocaat)
(2) From what post has he/she resigned? (Sunderland boss)
The Greater Ardoyne residents collective (GARC) is protesting against an agreement aimed at resolving a long-running dispute in the area.
A residents’ group has been granted permission for GARC to hold a parade on <red>the outskirts of Crumlin, County Antrim</red>.
A protest has been held in the Republic of Ireland calling for <red>an end to parading</red> parading in North Belfast.
A protest has been held in North Belfast over a protest against the Orange Order in North Belfast.
Church leaders have appealed to a nationalist residents’ group to call off a protest against an Orange Order parade in North Belfast.
(1) Where is the protest supposed to happen? (North Belfast)
(2) What are they protesting against? (An Orange Order parade)
